gloss: outside the group; outside one's department; nonmember

definitions.gloss: outside the group; outside one's department or organization
definitions.explanation: A formal noun used in administrative and corporate contexts to refer to people, things, or matters that are outside a particular department, division, or organization. The most common collocation is {部外者|ぶがいしゃ} ("outsider, nonmember"). Combines {部|ぶ} ("section, department, group") with {外|がい} ("outside").

examples.japanese: {部外|ぶがい}{者|しゃ}{立|た}ち{入|い}り{禁止|きんし}。
{部外|ぶがい}{秘|ひ}の{資料|しりょう}なので、{他|ほか}には{見|み}せないでください。
examples.english: This material is confidential to our department, so please don't show it to anyone else.

examples.japanese: {部外|ぶがい}からの{問|と}い{合|あ}わせは、{広報|こうほう}{部|ぶ}が{対応|たいおう}します。
examples.english: Inquiries from outside the department are handled by the public relations division.

examples.japanese: {今回|こんかい}の{会議|かいぎ}は{部内|ぶない}{限|かぎ}りで、{部外|ぶがい}の{方|かた}にはご{遠慮|えんりょ}いただいております。
examples.english: This meeting is internal-only, and we are asking those outside the department to refrain from attending.

notes:
{部外|ぶがい} is a formal compound used in workplaces, government offices, and other organizations to designate people or information as belonging outside a specific department or in-group. It rarely stands alone; it almost always appears as part of a longer compound — most prominently {部外者|ぶがいしゃ} ("outsider") and {部外|ぶがい}{秘|ひ} ("confidential, restricted to department members").

FORMS:
- {部|ぶ} ("department, division, group") + {外|がい} ("outside") → {部外|ぶがい}
- The pair word is {部内|ぶない} ("inside the department")

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {部外者|ぶがいしゃ}: outsider, nonmember
- {部外|ぶがい}{秘|ひ}: confidential to a department, internal-use only
- {部外|ぶがい}{者|しゃ}{立|た}ち{入|い}り{禁止|きんし}: "no unauthorized entry" (standard signage)
- {部外|ぶがい}{者|しゃ}に{漏|も}らす: to leak information to an outsider
- {部外|ぶがい}からの{問|と}い{合|あ}わせ: inquiries from outside the organization

SIMILAR / RELATED TERMS:
- {部内|ぶない}: inside the department, internal
- {社外|しゃがい}: outside the company
- {社内|しゃない}: inside the company (internal)
- {外部|がいぶ}: external, outside (more general; can refer to any external entity)
- {内部|ないぶ}: internal, inside (the general counterpart of {外部|がいぶ})
- {関係|かんけい}{者|しゃ}{以外|いがい}: "non-related parties" (more colloquial signage equivalent)

USAGE:
- {部外|ぶがい} is fairly formal and appears most often in administrative or corporate writing, including signs, memos, and policy documents. In casual speech, {外|そと}の{人|ひと} or {関係|かんけい}{者|しゃ}{以外|いがい} are more natural.
- {部外|ぶがい}{秘|ひ} is one step less restrictive than {社外|しゃがい}{秘|ひ} ("company confidential") and {社内|しゃない}{秘|ひ} ("internal company confidential"); the choice signals exactly which group can see the document.
